coverage.tutorial: Initial objective and in-game Undo tutorial are captured; Settings replay catalog and its external YouTube handoff are captured, including top and lower catalog states.
coverage.gameplay: Computer Classic, 2-player setup, die roll, computer six/token entry, blue six/token entry, menu, and quit confirmation captured.
coverage.settings: Home Settings screen and Tutorial Play catalog captured, including Audio, Vibration, Language, privacy, themes, store, support, rules, and tutorial rows.
coverage.monetization: First-run King Pass, coins, theme, playable ad, banners, relaunch coin/diamond offer, Water Sort ad, diamond offer, Deals & Offers, and persistent No Ads rewarded offer captured.
coverage.exitFlow: Exit menu and quit-confirmation states were captured before and after manual Touch Lock dismissal; YES closed the dialog but left the board visible in the observed state.
coverage.systemOverlay: Frames 57-61 document Samsung Game Booster Touch Lock and unsuccessful automated drags. The user manually dismissed it, after which frames 62 onward continue the reference study.
gaps: Full tutorial replay/step-by-step Next flow inside the game
